summary: Gorilla Technology Group filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an 8-K, used by foreign private issuers) addressed to holders of its $125,000,000 7.50% Senior Unsecured Convertible Notes Series B due 2031, issued July 17, 2026. The company's CEO signed the notice advising that it intends to file a prospectus supplement on October 15, 2026 and circulated a draft to known noteholders on September 30, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or ownership terms are disclosed. This is a routine registration-rights administrative notice, not a special situation; watch only for resale-overhang and dilution risk on filing.
